scripts.start: npx concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "dotnet watch run --project backend"
scripts.build:prod-linux: echo '--- BUILDING FRONTEND (LINUX) ---' && npm run build --prefix frontend && echo '--- PREPARING BACKEND ---' && rm -rf backend/wwwroot && mkdir backend/wwwroot && cp -r frontend/dist/* backend/wwwroot/ && echo '--- PUBLISHING BACKEND ---' && dotnet publish backend -c Release -o ./publish
scripts.build:prod-win: echo '--- BUILDING FRONTEND (WINDOWS) ---' && npm run build --prefix frontend && echo '--- PREPARING BACKEND ---' && (if exist backend\wwwroot rmdir /s /q backend\wwwroot) && mkdir backend\wwwroot && xcopy frontend\dist\* backend\wwwroot\ /s /e /i /y && echo '--- PUBLISHING BACKEND ---' && dotnet publish backend -c Release -o .\publish
scripts.build:prod: echo '--- BUILDING FRONTEND (CROSS-PLATFORM) ---' && npm run build --prefix frontend && echo '--- PREPARING BACKEND ---' && rimraf backend/wwwroot && copyfiles -u 1 "frontend/dist/**/*" backend/wwwroot && echo '--- PUBLISHING BACKEND ---' && dotnet publish backend -c Release -o ./publish
